messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's current action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, following the demonstrated action in the motion reference. Transfer only the demonstrated action; do not adopt the reference person's appearance, the reference scene, or the reference camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video, including the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's current action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, following the demonstration in the reference video. Transfer only the demonstrated action, not the reference person's appearance or the reference scene and camera setup. Preserve all other aspects of the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands still, then raises both arms overhead, jumps with bent knees, and lands back into the original standing pose.","camera":"Static medium-full shot at roughly waist-to-head height, keeping the character centered in frame.","clothing":"White long-sleeved shirt under a dark brown vest, reddish-orange trousers, and dark slip-on shoes.","hair_color":"Bright yellow.","hairstyle":"Short, flat-topped hair covering the crown of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build and light skin, shown in profile and three-quarter views.","scene":"An outdoor urban plaza with a large gray concrete block behind the character, paved ground, and buildings with yellow scaffolding in the background."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output replaces the source's subtle standing/turning motion with a celebration sequence: the character raises both arms overhead, jumps with bent knees, and lands back into the original standing pose. The character's yellow hair, clothing, urban plaza scene, lighting, and static camera framing remain consistent with the source.
arguments.requested_change: Change the person's action to raising both hands in celebration, then thrusting one hand upward, following the reference motion while preserving the person's identity, appearance, scene, lighting, and camera framing.
uncertain: Whether the final upward hand thrust is distinct enough from the overall two-arms-raised celebration to fully match the reference's second phase.
unexpected_changes: The output includes a jump with bent knees, which is part of the reference motion but was not explicitly mentioned in the user's requested action description.
